title: Traceable agent descriptor (v1)
description: What the owner signs. Signed as canonical JSON (keys sorted recursively, no whitespace, UTF-8) with the owner's Ed25519 key; a child is also signed by the parent agent's key over the same bytes.

id.description: An Ed25519 public key as a W3C did:key (multicodec 0xed01, base58btc, multibase z).

owner.description: An Ed25519 public key as a W3C did:key (multicodec 0xed01, base58btc, multibase z).

kind.description: agent, human, service… the owner's word for what this is.

environment.description: Chosen at issue and fixed; a sub-agent takes its parent's.

parent.description: The parent agent's did:key, for an agent made by another agent.
